slap verb and noun

on water

also slap the water, smack

classical

plangō, plangere, plānxī, plānctum

verb, third conjugation · Conjugation on Wiktionary

strike with a smack

aquam palmīs plangit is modelled on plangēbant aliae prōcērīs tympana palmīs (Catull. 64.261).

Other words

  • plangor, plangōris m. — the slap of water, of waves

    noun, third declension · classical · Catull. 64.273 · Declension on Wiktionary

  • plānctus

    avoid · classical · Wiktionary

    Nearly always means beating the breast in mourning.

Examples

  • aquam palmīs plangit

    he slaps the water with his palmscomposed

  • Nōlī aquam plangere!

    Don’t slap the water!composed

See also splash.
